statement: In higher dimensions, we have not tried to optimize the number of logarithmic factors in the update time, but the ideas in Section 3 should help. A more intriguing question is whether O(polylog n + k logd−2−δ n) query time is achievable with O(polylog n) update time. Even for the static problem, we do not know how to get O(polylog n + k) query time with O(n polylog n) space; current techniques only give O(polylog n + k logd−3 n) query time [7].
context: The main open question is whether O(polylog n + k) query time is achievable with O(polylog n) update time in 2D. In higher dimensions, we have not tried to optimize the number of logarithmic factors in the update time, but the ideas in Section 3 should help. A more intriguing question is whether O(polylog n + k logd−2−δ n) query time is achievable with O(polylog n) update time. Even for the static problem, we do not know how to get O(polylog n + k) query time with O(n polylog n) space; current techniques only give O(polylog n + k logd−3 n) query time [7].
